parameters.text:
=You are analyzing a job search tracker for a candidate using an AI job application assistant.

Current period stats:
{{ JSON.stringify($json.current_period) }}

{{ $json.has_comparison ? 'Prior period stats: ' + JSON.stringify($json.prior_period) + '\nDeltas vs prior period: ' + JSON.stringify($json.deltas) : 'No prior-period comparison is available for this run (full history view).' }}

Raw gap notes identified across applications in this period:
- {{ $json.gaps_identified_raw.length ? $json.gaps_identified_raw.join('\n- ') : '(none identified)' }}

Based on this, produce:
1. A short 2-3 sentence summary of how the job search is going{{ $json.has_comparison ? ', including how this period compares to the previous one' : '' }}. Use your own words, not the raw numbers restated mechanically.
2. 2-4 recurring gap themes: cluster similar gap notes together into short, distinct themes, phrased in your own words (do not copy the raw notes verbatim).
3. 2-3 concrete, specific next actions the candidate should take to close those gaps or improve their application strategy.

Respond only with the structured fields requested.

assignments.name: stats
assignments.value: ={{ { current_period: $('Code in JavaScript').item.json.current_period, prior_period: $('Code in JavaScript').item.json.prior_period, deltas: $('Code in JavaScript').item.json.deltas, has_comparison: $('Code in JavaScript').item.json.has_comparison } }}
